suite: M2 company and chartered bank shared Credit UI
fixture_conditions: Populated bfi_visual bank fixture plus native company HQ; test-only 1000 company cash grant, trade mandate and selection. Normal charter conversion is not tested by this visual fixture.
scope: Five manual shared Credit layout observations in a disposable Florence campaign with both a chartered bank and native operating company. No additional financial transaction or normal-charter acceptance is claimed.

observations.chartered_bank_overview: Bardi Merchant Finance is Operating; treasury 1345.98, assets 1845.98, liabilities 100 and equity 1745.98, with both ownership/asset charts visible.
observations.company_statement_with_bank: On the same Lending & Investments tab, Liguria and Corsica shows its separate 1000 cash, 100 buffer, native net budget 7.89, one owned facility, and zero trade earnings/payout. The company wallet is fixture setup, not earned income.
observations.company_commands_scroll: Dragging the company scrollbar reveals trade/exploration mandates, capital, crew and native-route controls; the bank overview remains visible.
observations.independent_scroll_regions: Dragging the bank investment scrollbar changes its instrument rows while the company command viewport remains in the same position.
observations.native_controls_remain: Take over loan, Offer a Loan, native search and loan-list controls remain below the two investment viewports without covering the company section.

image_handling: Unedited full game-window PNGs, including window border; no resizing/compositing.
validation: 86 offline tests and source/native-pin checks pass; production runtime unchanged.
limitations: Only the recorded English 1280x720 layout at 60% GUI scale is inspected. Release-wide languages/resolutions and finance behavior retain their separate evidence.
